system.name: KAN (Kolmogorov-Arnold Network)
system.one_liner: Neural networks with learnable univariate activation functions on edges and summation on nodes, proposed as an alternative to MLPs.

content.variant_note: a ruled comparison table: MLP in the left column, KAN in the right, six aligned rows from the governing theorem through shallow and deep formulas to network drawings (a) to (d)
content.argues: MLPs and KANs rest on different theorems: MLPs have fixed activations on nodes and learnable weights on edges, KANs have learnable activation functions on edges and plain sums on nodes.
content.subject: a table comparing MLP and KAN by theorem, shallow and deep formulas and four network drawings

lessons.what_to_learn: Compare two architectures in a ruled table with row headers for theorem, formula and drawing, and draw both networks on the same skeleton so the one difference (activation glyphs on edges instead of nodes) stands out, with italic call-outs naming it.
lessons.suits: Architecture proposals that replace one component of a familiar model and can be stated as a theorem, an equation and a node-link picture.

evidence: KANs place learnable activation functions on edges (“weights”), as illustrated in Figure 0.1.
In Figure 0.1 (c) and (d), we visualize a three-layer MLP and a three-layer KAN, to clarify their differences.

summary: The paper proposes Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks as an alternative to MLPs. Figure 0.1 is a ruled comparison table with an MLP column on the left and a KAN column on the right. Rows give the governing theorem (Universal Approximation versus Kolmogorov-Arnold Representation), the shallow and deep formulas, and four network drawings (a) to (d). The MLP drawings have fixed activation boxes on nodes and learnable weights on edges; the KAN drawings keep the same skeleton but put a learnable activation curve on every edge and plain summation dots on nodes. Italic call-outs with curved arrows and bracketed boxed labels (nonlinear fixed, linear learnable, nonlinear learnable) spell out the contrast. The figure is monochrome serif apart from red and blue edges inside the MLP bitmaps.
summary_zh: 论文提出 KAN 替代 MLP。图 0.1 是左 MLP、右 KAN 的对比表：逐行给出定理、浅层与深层公式和网络图 (a)–(d)。MLP 的激活固定在节点上，KAN 把可学习激活放在边上，节点只求和。
notes: The context says the figure is numbered 0.1 and has no separate legend; the red and blue edge colours inside the MLP bitmaps are not explained by the figure or the quoted paragraphs, and their palette values are approximate readings. The four network drawings are bitmaps but are drawings of the model, so they are listed as elements and not as pictures; the activation-curve count (about fifty) is an estimate.
